sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas showing a beaker of liquid with an object
partially or fully submerged. Sliders: object volume V (mL), object
density ρ_obj, liquid density ρ_liq. HUD: weight P = ρ_obj·V·g,
buoyancy Π = ρ_liq·V_immerged·g, net force, floating/sinking state.
Object animates: if ρ_obj < ρ_liq it floats; else it sinks. Both P
and Π arrows drawn on the object. Experiment: reach a target immersed
fraction (e.g., "iceberg hides 90% below waterline") by picking
density ratio. Evaluate: force arrows hidden; student predicts
float/sink from densities alone. Wrinkle: only equilibrium immersion
is animated (statics exercise at 2ème).
